blocks.raw: To configure the **Json-to-Csv-Converter** block, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To configure the Json-to-Csv-Converter block, follow these steps:

blocks.raw: i. Select the file format to convert from in the **Record Reader** drop-down.
blocks.text: i. Select the file format to convert from in the Record Reader drop-down.

blocks.raw:
| Reader         | Description                                               |
| :------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------- |
| CSVReader      | Input data is in CSV format.                              |
| AvroReader     | Input data is in [Avro](https://avro.apache.org/) format. |
| JSONTreeReader | Input data is in JSON format                              |

rows: Input data is in CSV format.

blocks.raw: ii. Select the file format to convert to in the **Record Writer** drop-down.
blocks.text: ii. Select the file format to convert to in the Record Writer drop-down.

blocks.raw:
| Writer                    | Description                                                                               |
| :------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| CSVRecordSetWriter        | Export data to CSV format.                                                                |
| JsonRecordSetWriter       | Export data to JSON.                                                                      |
| CustomerV2RecordSetWriter | Export data to [Customer V2](https://docs.capillarytech.com/reference/customer-1) format. |
